surface_mechanism_description: The surface reactions involve the self-limiting, alternate gas-to-solid reactions between the precursors and the depositing film. The films were deposited using a pulsing sequence of trimethylaluminum (TMA) combined with O3 and lithium tert-butoxide (LiOtBu)-H2O. The self-limiting surface reactions and linear growth behavior have been previously verified for this process.
evidence: The surface reactions involve the self-limiting, alternate gas-to-solid reactions between the precursors and the depositing film. The films were deposited using a pulsing sequence of trimethylaluminum (TMA) combined with O3 and lithium tert-butoxide (LiOtBu)-H2O. The self-limiting surface reactions and linear growth behavior have been previously verified for this process. XPS analysis revealed the presence of carbonates on the surface. Presumably, the lithium ions in these films are mobile and reactive and form carbonates and hydroxides upon reaction with ambient atmosphere.
